title: A coffee roaster
heading: A coffee
Roaster
summary: An example: a roaster’s site, with a shop page, a menu and the cart’s timetable.

body.p: The roaster started as a cart, selling coffee to people waiting for the morning ferry.
The timetable lives in **Site Settings**, so the roaster changes it without a developer. See [editing](/services/websites) for how.

ul: A shop page and a menu
A one-page timetable for the cart

body.p: Each part of the page is one of the site’s own blocks, edited where it sits.

A form for the block.
The preview beside it.

And a Publish button.
